verdict.rationale: Keycloak is open-source and self-hostable via Docker or the Kubernetes Operator, keeping deployment and data entirely under the operator's control, with community evidence confirming years of stable self-hosted production use and full control over infrastructure. Docs also cover FIPS compliance and reverse-proxy/gateway configuration for private network deployment, and it supports connecting to your own database/LDAP for user storage rather than relying on a vendor-hosted store. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation explicitly detailing supported external database backends/configuration for user data storage location.
